US Release Date: October 9, 2026
Starring: Stephen Curry, Viola Davis, Rick Rubin
Directed By: Gotham Chopra
Synopsis: On the verge of his record-extending 4,000th career three-pointer, four-time NBA champion and two-time MVP Stephen Curry reflects on the upbringing, mindset, and work ethic that made him one of the most legendary artists of his time. 
 
The film follows Curry through one remarkable game at Chase Center, where he needs two threes to reach the unprecedented milestone. Perspectives from Viola Davis, Rick Rubin, Patti Smith, and Jon Batiste place Curry’s generational artistry in a wider cultural conversation and show how his singular vision changed basketball.
